# Daniela Ruiz

**Who.** Operations director at Grupo Ferra, Monterrey (~200 people, metal parts for appliance makers). Reports to the family board. My sponsor since July.

**Phase one.** 29 of 38 supervisors active at close; 31 last week. Line-stop report from 40 minutes to 6.

**Phase two.** Two streams: shift assistant for the night shift, weekly dashboard. Photos parked. Board decides in two days.

**Her two questions (mail, two days ago).** Who owns the data after phase two. What I do when usage drops. Exo drafted the reply; I send it today before the dinner.

## Log
- **24 days ago** — phase one review.
- **10 days ago** — scope meeting with Rodrigo Fuentes.
- **7 days ago** — I sent the scope.
- **2 days ago** — her two questions.

## Next
Send the reply today. Quick call in two days after the board. Scope review in six days.
